lines.text: Because Israel did evil again, the LORD delivered them to the Ammonites for forty years, and Manoah of Zorah had a barren wife.
The angel of the LORD told the woman she would bear a son who would be a Nazirite and begin Israel's deliverance.
Manoah prayed, and the angel of God returned to the woman in the field, and Manoah followed her to him.
Manoah offered the angel a young goat, but the angel told him to offer a burnt offering on a rock to the LORD.
The angel ascended in the flame, and Manoah's wife later bore Samson, whom the Spirit began to stir at Mahaneh-dan.
